summary_text: Cycle-2N fix executed across 5 phases without rollback. Q4-C (Vercel empty env) fixed by removing+adding NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL in production and redeploying — token-mint API now returns the worker's LiveKit Cloud URL. Q1 (.env line 11 winning over systemd Environment=) fixed by commenting out the line and restarting worker — process env now has FISH_SPEECH_REFERENCE_ID=(empty). Q4-A (Fish process VQ-token cache) fixed by restarting prism42-fish — model re-warmed cleanly. Q4-B (greeting bypass with hardcoded references=[]) fixed by patching worker.py _warm_greeting_cache_blocking() to mirror the cycle-2j adapter pattern: read MW reference path/text from env, build references_payload, send via body. New event greeting.911.reference_voice_loaded confirms the fix on the wire. Greeting cache file now renders in MW voice (319532 bytes vs 380972 pre-fix). Watchdog GREEN. Synthetic caller PASS. Demo at https://prism42-console.vercel.app/prism42/livekit will now route through our pipeline (browser dials LiveKit Cloud, our worker is in Germany 2 region of same Cloud, agent reply path uses MW reference voice for both greeting and TTS turns). Production demo voice is now end-to-end ours.
rollback_instructions: 3. Restart Fish + Worker: ssh prism-mla-b300-h4h5 'sudo systemctl restart prism42-fish prism42-worker'
4. Vercel rollback: vercel rollback https://prism42-console-dfx6l3fft-goatnote.vercel.app  (the prior production URL)
5. Time-to-recover: ~5 min (Fish restart is the long pole, ~2 min to model-ready)
